accumulation_objection.objection: A proposal is one macro option and a productive delta is the whole remaining transport, so comparing them directly is unfair unless small steps fail to accumulate.
accumulation_objection.verdict: REFUTED as a rescue. Over the full 250-call budget the lineage producing each run's best molecule is only 7 edits deep (median, max 9), and the ACCUMULATED transformation reaches a median largest coherent changed region of 7 against the 14 required, retaining 79% of the root against the 40% productive transitions retain. Only 9% of runs accumulate to the 13-atom scale that 58% of productive transitions need. One run (perindopril_mpo) has lineage depth 0: its best molecule after 250 charged calls is an initialization molecule.

current_completion_channel.description: dynamic_program_synthesis._grow_actions builds a linear single-bonded chain of elements drawn uniformly from ('C','N','O'); segment_replace draws its length uniformly from 1..min(MAX_SEGMENT_LENGTH=8, 40-n). It can never install a ring, a branch, or an element outside C/N/O.

donor_completion_content.question: Can donor chemistry SUPPLY the completion content a required macro edit needs -- not whether donor transport works as a search strategy.
donor_completion_content.verdict: YES as completion content, and the marginal match is close: the task-independent objective-blind init bank supplies pendant components at median size 11 with 64.3% ring-bearing and 40.9% at or above 13 atoms, against a requirement of median 11, 80.6% ring-bearing and 36.1% at or above 13. The CURRENT completion channel can install none of it: _grow_actions builds a linear single-bonded C/N/O chain of at most 8 atoms, 0% ring, 0% branched. This is a marginal distribution match and is NECESSARY, NOT SUFFICIENT: it does not establish that the specific region a given transformation needs is available.

excluded_sources.diagnostics/ivg_winner_paths: competitor-derived (InVirtuoGen), target-informed, non-commercially licensed, and T4 DOCKING cells rather than PMO tasks. Read its audit file; NOT used anywhere in this census.

falsified: Point 6 mechanism -- "useful compound programs are rejected because intermediate states are scored or pruned before the complete structural option is realized" -- is REFUTED three ways: intermediate_task_evaluations is a hard-coded 0 on every composed program (2064/2064, and the constant is asserted across the codebase, so no intermediate is ever oracle-scored); 0 of 2064 programs were truncated (completed_module_count < requested_module_count); and the 51.3% of eligible programs the allocator discards are statistically indistinguishable in scale from the charged ones (largest touched region mean 3.24 vs 3.12, frac>=6 20.8% vs 21.1%).

The hypothesis that productive transitions are merely "two different drug-like molecules" is REFUTED by the null: random init-bank pairs reach the 13-atom scale 9.0% of the time against 58.3% for productive transitions.

The hypothesis that the large requirement is an artifact of aiming at a published answer is REFUTED by POOL_4, which uses no answer-known material on either side and reproduces the shape (median largest region 10.5, 100% multi-region, 80% not buildable as a grow chain) -- though at n=10.

The donor lane is NOT a contributor to these runs and cannot be: donor_program and donor_memory are absent from the scored entry point's import closure (independently reproduced by AST walk). The 42% figure is the joint_dependency_region_jump lane, not donor.
headline: The transitions are NOT heterogeneous: one generic family covers 88.9% of the productive census and two cover 100%, significantly more concentrated than a random drug-like pair (p=0.0014). The controller proposes the right TYPE occasionally and the right SCALE almost never: median largest coherent changed region is 14 atoms in productive transitions, 8 in a random pair, and 3 in the controller. Only 0.4% of its proposals reach the 13-atom scale that 58% of productive transitions need -- 22x below even the random-pair null.
information_regime_statement: Answer-known, panel-informed development evidence. POOL_1/2/3 targets are published task answers or teacher-spine checkpoints with measured V_local. NOTHING in this directory may become a prior, library, initialization or runtime policy for a scored no-prescreen run. The product is a TASK-INDEPENDENT structural grammar: every family and requirement is a predicate over the global graph delta alone, with no task identity, target structure or fragment content in any definition, so the vocabulary could be frozen before the official benchmark. POOL_4 additionally uses NO answer-known material on either side.

instrument_validation.direction_of_residual_bias: my MCS reports +0.19 atoms MORE change than production on the controller proposals, so the measured controller-vs-productive scale gap is CONSERVATIVE

known_limitations: POOL_4 (the only fairness-clean pool) is n=10 and POOL_1 is n=36 over 10 tasks; the per-task counts are 1-3, so no per-task claim is supported.

The productive target set is the set of points whose V_local was actually probed. A nearer productive point may exist that was never probed, so the measured requirement is an UPPER BOUND on the transformation scale needed to enter a productive region.

POOL_1 sources are off-manifold blind states (the manifold-drift finding), so part of the measured delta is the cost of returning to the drug-like manifold. POOL_3 controls for this by starting from on-manifold init-bank molecules and gives the same median (15 vs 14).
The MCS instrument and production actual_changes agree exactly on only 75% of charged rows (r=0.85); the residual bias is toward over-reporting controller change, so the gap is conservative.

One generic family covers 88.9% of the productive census, but that family label does not by itself separate productive transitions from random pairs (the null also lands 66.8% there). The discriminating content is in the SCALE parameter, not the family name.
question: Given that COMPOSE can execute the required transformations, why is the blind controller not proposing transformations of the correct qualitative TYPE and SCALE?
